answer_1.quote: We propose cross-modal attribute insertions -an approach that leverages cross-modal interactions in multimodal data to obtain meaningful text augmentations... These augmentations highlight vulnerabilities of multimodal models...

answer_2.quote: We measure the impact of perturbations in the text on the capabilities of multimodal models using task-specific metrics. We quantify text-to-image retrieval performance using mean reciprocal rank (MRR). For cross-modal entailment, we report standard classification metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score)... we compute mean cosine similarity Sim T-T′... Similarly, we report BLEU and METEOR...

answer_4.quote: We recruit human annotators using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT)... We asked annotators to indicate their agreement... using a 5-point Likert scale... Rate the caption quality for the given image based on the reference examples...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated caption quality and accuracy: (i) comparing XMAI vs. CLARE for 'better description' in quality/accuracy; (ii) rating caption quality on a 5-point Likert scale.
